warmer.name: WhatsApp Warmer

how.title: How it works
how.one: Turn warming on for a number.
how.two: Each day it may send a little more than the day before.
how.three: Messages go out slowly, only during the hours you choose.
how.four: Campaigns, broadcasts and scheduled sends all respect the limit.

good.title: Good to know
good.body: Warming lowers the risk of a ban on Unofficial API numbers — it is not a guarantee. For high volume, use an official WhatsApp Business (Cloud API) number, which needs no warming.

warmer.heading: Warm up your numbers
warmer.lead: Ramp each Unofficial API number's daily send limit with human-like gaps and active hours to reduce ban risk. Each number warms up on its own schedule.

hints.dailyBase: How many messages this number may send on day one.
hints.stepPct: Grow that daily limit by this percent each step.
hints.stepDays: How often the limit grows (every N days).
hints.maxDaily: The highest the daily limit ever reaches.
hints.activeStart: Only start sending after this hour (24-hour clock).

spintax.title: Spintax variety
spintax.hint: Send slightly different wording to each person so messages don't look identical. Write choices like '{Hi|Hello|Hey}' there.
